beats.headline: We become what we keep looking at.
beats.subtext: So what are we looking at, for hours every day?
beats.narration: We become what we keep looking at. So what are we looking at, for hours every day?
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते । सङ्गात्संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते ॥

beats.headline: What we dwell on, we cling to.
beats.subtext: “Dwelling on sense-objects, a person grows attached to them.”
beats.narration: Krishna told Arjuna: dwelling on sense-objects, a person grows attached to them.

beats.headline: Today our phone proves him right.
beats.subtext: Every time you open it: reels, or Rama?
beats.narration: Today, our phones prove him right. Every time you open yours, what do you choose? Reels, or Rama?

beats.headline: Change what you scroll.
beats.subtext: The Ramayana and the Bhagavad Gita, one shloka at a time, with its meaning.
beats.narration: Change what you scroll. The Ramayana and the Bhagavad Gita, one shloka at a time, with its meaning, in English and Hindi.

beats.headline: Krishna didn't ask for hours.
beats.subtext: Pick a time. A daily verse will be waiting.
beats.narration: Krishna didn't ask for hours. Even a little each day is enough. Pick a time, and a daily verse will be waiting for you.

beats.headline: My Sanatan
beats.subtext: We give reels hours every day. Give Bhagavan a few minutes.
beats.narration: My Sanatan. We give reels hours every day. Give Bhagavan a few minutes.
